summary: First-iteration full E2E test of CENADEP NGO site. Backend pytest: 17/18 passed (1 failure on Stripe /api/donations/status returning 500). Frontend Playwright: 8/8 critical flows working (chatbot, home, blog list, AI summary, contact form, admin login+CMS, donation->Stripe redirect, lang toggle). AI integrations (Gemini 3 chat + summary) work and Stripe checkout creation works. Donation status polling endpoint is broken because Stripe cannot find the just-created session via the Emergent integration proxy.

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 500 (CheckoutError: 'No such checkout.session') for sessions that were JUST created via POST /api/donations/checkout (same proxy). Even after a 5s delay Stripe says 'No such checkout.session'. This breaks the /don/merci page polling flow. The exception is unhandled and bubbles up to a 500. Recommend: wrap stripe_checkout.get_checkout_status in try/except and (a) fall back to the local payment_transactions doc, or (b) return 202/{payment_status:'pending'} until the session is visible. Also investigate why Emergent Stripe proxy creates a session that is not retrievable by the same key.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Made with Emergent' badge in the bottom-right slightly overlaps the chatbot floating toggle button at 1440x900 viewport. Real users can still click, but the corner of the toggle is hit-tested by the badge. Consider raising chatbot z-index OR shifting it up (e.g., bottom-24) to avoid overlap on small screens.

integration_issues.issue: Because /api/donations/status returns 500, the DonationSuccess polling page will likely show an error / never complete. Front-end UX after Stripe redirect back will be broken until backend status endpoint is fixed.

action_items: BACKEND HIGH: Fix /api/donations/status to handle Stripe 'No such checkout.session' gracefully (try/except returning {payment_status:'pending', status:'open'} when session not yet visible) — current behavior crashes /don/merci polling.

Investigate root cause: Emergent Stripe proxy creates a session that is then not retrievable via the same emergentintegrations key/proxy (req IDs differ between create and retrieve calls). Maybe webhook_url construction is wrong or proxy uses different account.
Minor: increase z-index or position offset of chatbot toggle so it doesn't visually overlap Emergent watermark.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py donations_status has no error handling around the third-party call — any Stripe error leaks as 500. Always wrap external SDK calls in try/except in API endpoints.
All backend endpoints correctly strip Mongo _id via projection {_id:0} — good.
JWT secret hardcoded fallback removed (uses os.environ['JWT_SECRET']) — good, but server fails fast if missing which is desired.
Donation amounts are validated server-side via DONATION_PACKAGES dict, custom_amount has min 1.0 — solid.
Seed admin uses bcrypt.hashpw correctly and uses idempotent insert. Good.
Frontend: data-testid coverage across pages is very good for automated testing.
Chatbot.jsx: clicking outside or pressing Escape doesn't close window — minor UX gap.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (8/8 critical flows after chatbot retry via JS click)

seed_data_creation: Seed data (admin + 5 blog posts) is auto-created on backend startup; verified all 5 posts present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file is at /app/backend/tests/test_cenadep_api.py — re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_cenadep_api.py -v. The single failure is TestDonations::test_checkout_package on the status poll. After main agent fixes /api/donations/status, only that test needs re-run. Frontend: chatbot toggle works but a force-click via Playwright at the badge-overlap area can miss; use JS click via page.evaluate or click at slight offset.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause for donation status 500: emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.StripeCheckout.get_checkout_status invokes stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve(session_id) which raises InvalidRequestError 'No such checkout.session'. This is raised even though POST /donations/checkout just succeeded with the same session_id. Likely the Emergent Stripe proxy routes create vs. retrieve to different Stripe accounts/keys, OR there's an eventual-consistency delay > our 5s. Reproduction: POST /api/donations/checkout {package_id:'small', origin_url:'<base>'} → get session_id → immediately GET /api/donations/status/{session_id} → 500. Mitigation in code: wrap call in try/except CheckoutError and return cached payment_transactions row with payment_status='pending'.
